column1: # TGC Initial LAB partition table (scheme id: tgc-ota-16mb).
# Designed in this repo for the board-verified 16MB flash of the TGC LAB
# profile TGC_LAB_ESP32S3_16M (read-only esptool flash_id on COM11
# 2026-09-04: "Detected flash size: 16MB"). Layout is original to TGC and is
# NOT copied from the TMM tmm-ota-4mb table: OTA slots are 3MB each to leave
# generous headroom for future TGC firmware
# 0x620000 stays unallocated for future storage needs.
